decisive_items: well-circumscribed, 11.8 cm cystic mass in the pancreatic head
cystic lesion in the head of the pancreas
response.rationale: The well-circumscribed cystic mass in the pancreatic head, normal CA 19-9, and lack of pancreatitis history favor serous cystadenoma over mucinous neoplasms or pseudocyst.

rejected.why: Thrombocytosis is a red herring; the pancreatic mass is the primary issue.
No history of pancreatitis makes pseudocyst unlikely.
IPMN typically involves duct communication and often presents with pancreatitis; not supported.
MCN is less likely in the pancreatic head and often associated with elevated CA 19-9.
